title: Charging carbon to build a leaf: does the canopy still read as canopy?
question: Leaves now cost carbon to build, so a node builds the spray it can pay for instead of always a full one. Foliage is down ~30% per plant. Does the thinner stand still read as trees with crowns, or has it tipped into brown speckle?
context_md: 24 trees in 512 columns so crowns touch; frame 28,800. Over 8 world seeds: median leaf cells per plant 1227 -> 857 (-30%), leaves down in 15 of 16 runs. Total cells move in no consistent direction (7 up, 9 down) -- a reallocation, not a tax. Seeds set 42 -> 140. Germinations 24 -> 24, i.e. tripling seed supply changed recruitment by nothing.
